data.title: San Jose Earthquakes’ Ousseni Bouda, Angus Gunn, Ronaldo Vieira Called to International Duty | San Jose Earthquakes
data.content:
SAN JOSE, Calif. — The San Jose Earthquakes announced today that forward Ousseni Bouda (Burkina Faso), goalkeeper Angus Gunn (Scotland) and midfielder Ronaldo Vieira (Guinea-Bissau) have been called to international duty for the upcoming window.

Bouda, 26, has been called up to represent the Burkina Faso men's national team for a pair of Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) Qualifiers against Mauritania on Friday, Nov. 13 (8 a.m. PT), and Monday, Nov. 16 (11 a.m. PT). [...] At the international level, Bouda has earned 17 caps for Burkina Faso, scoring two goals. He netted his first international goal for Les Étalons on Sept. 6, 2024, during 2025 AFCON qualifying against Senegal, helping his country secure a 1-1 draw.

Gunn, 30, will join Scotland’s national team for UEFA Nations League Group Stage play against North Macedonia on Friday, Nov. 13 (11:45 a.m. PT), and Switzerland on Monday, Nov. 16 (11:45 a.m. PT). [...] ## Related Stories

data.title: Three Rapids players receive call ups for November international window | Colorado Rapids
data.content:
Minoungou, 24, will be with Burkina Faso for a pair of AFCON qualifying matches. The winger joined the group on November 8 in Burkina Faso and will be with them through November 18. The country will prepare for two matches against Mauritania, one at home on November 13 and the other on the road on November 17. [...] Since receiving his first international call up with Burkina Faso in September of 2025, Minoungou has been a regular within his country's national team. Overall, Minoungou Minougou has made 14 appearances for his nation, four of which came in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations last year. [...] Colorado Rapids
